proof.source: The physical LTYPE XDATA sequence is bound to its APPID. Each ELLIPSE target is uniquely identified by source handle, physical section, block-record owner, parsed callback, exact DRW_Ellipse dynamic type, center, major axis, ratio and parameter sentinels.
proof.output: For both source sections and all four encoding pairs, emitted physical XDATA is checked in order against the remapped ELLIPSE handle. The model-space target is emitted in ENTITIES under *Model_Space; the named target remains in BLOCKS under AuthorityBlock. Fresh typed readback verifies exact owner and ELLIPSE geometry. The binary group-42 end parameter is decoded directly from its emitted eight IEEE-754 bytes and compared with 2π within 1e-12; ASCII output is checked from its physical group value.
proof.failure_retry: For each section and encoding pair, removing the ELLIPSE target refuses export and preserves the prior destination; restoring it permits same-adapter retry. Separate late-mutation probes change the target handle after APPID emission in ENTITIES and BLOCKS; finalization refuses without replacing the destination, and restoring the original handle permits same-adapter retry with physical output and typed readback.
